description: A WinUI 3 MVVM app needs a clean way to show a ContentDialog that requires XamlRoot, based on https://stackoverflow.com/questions/78321069/how-to-display-a-contentdialog-in-winui-3-mvvm.
prompt: I'm trying to open an Add Song dialog from a context menu command in my WinUI 3 MVVM app. The view model can't access XamlRoot, and when I move the dialog content into its own UserControl the TextBox-bound values are still empty when I save.
